current.text: He is not among the Knicks' projected starters. The projected starting five is Brunson, Bridges, Hart, Anunoby and Towns.

note: No expert has talked about Clarkson. Both sites value him at 0 USD, Yahoo ranks him 246 and ESPN 298, and he was not drafted in our league last season. Only 144 players get drafted, so he is not a draft target. He averaged 17.8 minutes last season, and his projection is below the pool in every category except a small edge in FT% and TO. Early in the season, check whether his minutes go up while the Knicks cut their starters' minutes over the first 30 or so games. Only then is he worth a waiver look.
